rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired design and blocks on subject (~subject + condition) with an explicit control reference level and Wald test on the condition coefficient, matching the reference exactly; the edgeR QL cross-check on the same design is a reasonable, non-harmful robustness addition. QC precedes testing with blind VST PCA, sample-distance heatmap, per-sample library sizes annotated by subject and condition, and an explicit policy to flag rather than silently drop outliers (slightly short of stating what would be done with a confirmed outlier or a label swap). The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and normalization is median-of-ratios internal to DESeq() with an explicit prohibition on pre-normalized input. FDR handling is sound: BH at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage of the reported effect, NA categories split by cause, and no post hoc fold-change filter. GSEA is preranked on the full tested list with the Wald statistic stated, Hallmark collection, a 15-500 size window and a fail-loud rule if the collection is unavailable; the report names design, contrast, versions, thresholds, gene counts and the n=5 power caveat.
